'''''Watsonia densiflora''''' is a plant belonging to the genus ''[[Watsonia (plant)|Watsonia]]''.<ref>http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1557-24 REDLIST Sanbi</ref> The species is endemic to [[KwaZulu-Natal]] and the [[Eastern Cape]].<ref>http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:441910-1 Plants of the World Online</ref>
